prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 1536×1024 landscape north-star desktop web app comp for a visual-direction decision
Primary request: Design CueBench’s complete evidence-led caption and audio-description workbench first viewport in the “Hard-Plane Review” world, fusing Precisionist industrial plates with CueBench’s real teacher captioning workflow. Video, timeline, findings, and docket are interlocking hard-edged planes; the active plane alone takes the raking light. This must unmistakably be an OPERATE surface, not a landing page, poster, or chatbot.
Structure: a slim project/state strip; a dominant video plane on the left; a waveform and caption/AD timeline plane overlapping its lower edge; a slate review-docket plane on the right; a narrow Court Record plane at the bottom. The selection must connect video, playhead, cue span, finding, and docket while maintaining predictable editing controls.
Real product content: product name “CueBench”; project “Gibbs Free Energy — Lesson 4”; video frame of a teacher beside a scientific slide; selected cue “C05 · 00:12.400 → 00:15.100 · Dr. Nguyen explains Gibbs free energy.”; docket statuses Proposed, Objected, Sustained, Agent Ready; quality summary “2 blockers · 3 warnings”; finding “Name uncertainty: Dr. Nguyen”; human-only actions “Object” and “Sustain”; WebMCP state “Agent connected”; Court Record line “Agent revised C05 · You sustained C06”. Include one small audio-description lane.
Visual world: Precisionist painted industrial plate. Chalk white, slate, deep slate, rust, and ash in flat unmodulated geometric planes; one raking light source makes hard shadows; painted steel and cast-mineral surface textures. Interlocking planes replace generic cards, active controls take the light, inactive planes fall into their own shadow. Use a condensed industrial display only for numerals and compact labels; all caption prose must use a highly readable workhorse sans. Strong structural geometry without making the accessibility work hostile.
Constraints: show a complete coherent desktop application first viewport; all core regions visible; no large marketing numeral, no grain-elevator imagery, no poster layout, no chat panel, no speech bubbles, no gavel, no courtroom cosplay, no neon, no generic AI dashboard, no login, no device frame, no watermark.
